LanguageData.APM_Mech_Frostivus.label: Frostivus
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Frostivus.description: A very unique mechanoid, the frostivus is a mobile cryogenic chamber. It consumes organic material such as foodstuffs to store, freeze and dispense at request. It can be commanded to seal a targeted pawn inside of itself to store for the mechhive to later utilize for its twisted machinations.
